title: Marchantia Protoplast Isolation
author: Christian Boehm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gmubu6w

steps.title: Prepare Solution 1 (S1)
steps.instruction: Prepare S1 by dissolving 6% (w/v) Mannitol in half-strength Gamborg's B5 medium and filter sterilizing.

steps.title: Prepare Solution 2 (S2)
steps.instruction: Prepare S2 by dissolving 2% (w/v) Driselase and 6% (w/v) Mannitol in half-strength Gamborg's B5 medium and filter sterilizing.

steps.title: Pre-treat Sporelings with S1
steps.instruction: Pour S1 directly onto an agar plate containing 10-14 day old Marchantia sporelings.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 30min at room temperature without agitation.

steps.title: Digest Sporelings with S2
steps.instruction: Replace S1 with S2, ensuring all sporelings are covered.

substeps.instruction: Carefully pour S1 off the agar plate.
Incubate in the dark at room temperature for 2-10 hours without agitation.

steps.title: Detach Protoplasts
steps.instruction: Gently shake the agar plate for 10 seconds to detach the protoplasts.

steps.title: Filter Protoplast Suspension
steps.instruction: Pour the protoplast-containing S2 through a 40 μM Nylon mesh to remove debris.
